title: Finite family matrix reindexing
statement: For a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, a natural number $m$, and a type $\alpha$, reindexing a function on $\{0,\ldots,|\mathcal F|m-1\}$ gives an equivalent function assigning to each member of $\mathcal F$ a function on $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, with values in $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
